items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: When Purdie plays the band elevates.

ctx.x: I see another strong personality here on your list, Bernard Purdie.

Purdie. Yes. Yeah Purdie’s a master man. You know it’s as simple as that. He’s strong, he’s determined, he knows music and he knows what he’s looking for in his sound and he knows how to make it work. When Purdie plays the band elevates. You know? There are a few drummers that I’ll say yeah there are a few drummers that make that happen. You know? Purdie is one of them. You know you could have a band that’s playing really well and then you stick Purdie in there, the band’s going to elevate. The sound, the whole…
That’s a really special way to get to know somebody. Like I don’t even know who this person is and all of a sudden they’re lifting you up.
